root_cause.text: The `xfs_alloc_buftarg()` function in the XFS filesystem subsystem fails to release the DAX device reference acquired during initialization when an error occurs, causing a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the insertion of `fs_put_dax(btp->bt_daxdev, mp);` into the `error_free:` block of `fs/xfs/xfs_buf.c`, confirming the missing cleanup operation identified in the CVE description.
